parsed.name: EmStat Pico微型恒电位仪模块
parsed.description: EmStat Pico是一种小型电化学测量模块，属于恒电位仪类设备，常用于电化学传感器测试、基础电化学实验和便携式分析仪器集成。它通常通过串口与上位机通信，用于控制测量过程并读取电化学实验数据。
parsed.description_en: The EmStat Pico is a compact electrochemical measurement module in the potentiostat family. It is commonly used for electrochemical sensor testing, basic electrochemistry experiments, and integration into portable analytical instruments. It typically communicates with a host computer over a serial interface to control measurements and retrieve experimental data.
